OBSERVED: packages/auth/security-incident.ts recordAuthSecurityIncidentTx creates SecurityIncident records and writes both EventLog.incidentId and AuditLog.incidentId with the SecurityIncident id.
packages/orch-core/system-state.ts also creates SecurityIncident as a primary terminal incident for terminal transitions without a pipeline-run FreezeIncident path.
packages/api/canonical.ts auditTruthRows renders every non-null AuditLog.incidentId as /api/incidents/<incidentId>.
packages/api/canonical.ts handleIncident resolves only prisma.freezeIncident.findUnique and therefore cannot resolve SecurityIncident ids emitted by the active system.
packages/api/health.ts explicitly reads both FreezeIncident and SecurityIncident stores, confirming SecurityIncident is an active canonical evidence source rather than dead storage.
The resulting canonical audit incident_link can point to a guaranteed 404 for a valid active SecurityIncident.
EXPECTED: A canonical incident link emitted by the audit surface must resolve to incident detail for the referenced active primary incident, or the system must not emit that link.
GET /api/incidents/:id is a generic incident-detail route under final DOC-C and must not silently support only one active incident store while canonical producers emit another.
Repair must preserve RBAC and fail closed; do not invent SecurityIncident response/tenancy semantics not supported by active authority.

SPEC_EVIDENCE.route: Final DOC-C §4.2 paragraphs 10331-10340: GET /api/incidents/:id, purpose incident detail, session required, OWNER/AUDITOR, audit INCIDENT_VIEWED.
SPEC_EVIDENCE.incident_law: Final DOC-C §5.6 paragraphs 10494-10499 requires primary incidents for FREEZE/STOP transitions and incident linkage/audit evidence.
SPEC_EVIDENCE.known_spec_gap: F-C-SOL-V8-1737-GLOBAL-API-ROUTE-DENOMINATOR already records that GET /api/incidents/:id lacks a local response schema, retry policy, and error matrix.

SOURCE_EVIDENCE.prisma_schema: SecurityIncident and FreezeIncident are separate active models.

REPRODUCTION: Create or inspect any auth SecurityIncident produced by recordAuthSecurityIncidentTx; its AuditLog row has incidentId equal to the SecurityIncident id.
Read the row through handleAuditLogs: auditTruthRows emits /api/incidents/<SecurityIncident id>.
Call handleIncident with that id: the handler queries only freezeIncident.findUnique and returns not found.
Observe that no securityIncident.findUnique path exists in the canonical incident-detail handler.
